400	For the revelation of the names is the attainment of knowledge of His divinity, blessed be He.	Pois a revelação dos nomes é a compreensão da divindade Dele, bendito seja.
401	Attaining knowledge of His divinity, blessed be He, is the greatest delight there can be.	Compreender a divindade Dele, bendito seja, é o maior prazer que pode existir.
402	So that is one point.	Então isso é um ponto.
403	The essential difference between the illuminated state and the darkened state	A diferença essencial entre o estado iluminado e o estado obscurecido
404	lies in the recognition of the divine relationship to the nation, and to all who depend on it, that they rise with its ascent and descend	está no reconhecimento da relação divina com a nação, e com todos os que dela dependem, que eles sobem com a sua subida e descem
405	with its descent.	com a sua descida.
406	"And it shall be on that day, you will call Me 'my husband' and you will no longer call Me	"E será naquele dia que me chamarás 'meu marido', e não me chamarás mais	
407	'my master.'"	'meu senhor'."
408	"And I will remove the names of the Baalim from her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by their name."	"E removerei os nomes dos Baalim da sua boca, e não serão mais lembrados pelo seu nome."
409	The divine relationship to the nation, the bond with Knesset	A relação divina com a nação, o vínculo com Knesset
410	Yisrael, one can call it "my husband," one can	Yisrael, pode-se chamá-lo de "meu marido", pode-se
411	call it "my master"; there are levels in this.	chamá-lo de "meu senhor"; há níveis nisso.
412	According to our	De acordo com a nossa
413	purification, so our bond with the Creator	purificação, assim o nosso vínculo com o Criador
414	grows stronger.
415	And so Knesset Yisrael will not call "my husband" and will no longer call "my master," which is a lower level.
416	Behold, through the names we see the bond
417	and the relationship of the Holy One, blessed be He, to the nation, Knesset Yisrael.
418	Everything is revealed through the names.
419	Now, regarding the Name Mem-Bet, and another nineteen,
420	there are many Names of forty-two.
421	In the Tikunei Zohar it is written that the Name Mem-Bet is in the head of every level,
422	and the Name Ayin-Bet is in the body, in the body of every level.
423	The letter Yud-Tet below.
424	So the Rav says, when one sees...
425	a strengthening of torrents of lights from below to above.
426	Ah, one more thing I brought here in the introduction.
427	In the head, that is, in the head of every spiritual level, the lights rise from below to above; this is a rule.
428	Every spiritual level has a head and a body.
429	In the head the lights rise from below to above.
430	In the body of every spiritual level the lights spread from above to below.
431	So according to what I brought earlier, the Tikunei Zohar, that in the head the Name Mem-Bet shines, in the body the Name Ayin-Bet,
432	the Name Mem-Bet is lights that go from below to above,
433	and Ayin-Bet, which is in the body, from above to below.
434	The Rav says, when one sees a strengthening of torrents of lights from below
435	to above, what is this?
436	Which Name?
437	Then we need to draw from the Name Mem-Bet.
438	What, he spoke Kabbalah, the Rav? Do you see what this is?
439	This is Kovetz Alef, section Tav-Tav, Tzaddik-Bet.
